name: io.github.LeonardMichalas/peering-mcp
description: Look up how networks connect on the public internet: who peers with whom, where they meet, under what policy, and who an address range is registered to.

environmentVariables.name: PEERINGDB_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: A free PeeringDB API key. Recommended, not required: it raises the rate limit, and every tool works without one.

environmentVariables.name: PEERING_MCP_CACHE_TTL
environmentVariables.description: How long a cached upstream response stays usable, in seconds.

environmentVariables.name: PEERING_MCP_CACHE_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Where the on-disk cache lives. Defaults to $XDG_CACHE_HOME/peering-mcp.

environmentVariables.name: PEERING_MCP_NO_CACHE
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to disable caching. Slower, and harder on the upstream APIs.

environmentVariables.name: PEERING_MCP_MAX_RETRIES
environmentVariables.description: Attempts before an upstream failure is reported.
